topic_detail: A static screenshot of Matan's text post listing the ten 'most useless and irrelevant' academic degrees for the coming academic year, ranked 'from the least bad to the worst'.
audience: students choosing a degree and followers who follow his anti-degree line
caption_vs_video_note: Caption 'תרשמו איזה עוד תארים היו צריכים להיכנס לרשימה👇' asks viewers to add degrees to the list; the video is exactly the list as a still post, so they match.

opening.s0_1: No motion: the post is shown fully from the first frame.
opening.s1_3: Unchanged still for the whole 3 s.
opening.visual_hook: A ranked list of ten degrees with a provocative title, in text only.

opening.first_sentence_standalone: yes: 'here is the list of the most useless degrees for the coming academic year' stands alone
opening.number_or_money_in_first_3s: no (numbers 1 to 10 label the list, no money)

visual.subject_placement: Post text block is centred, starting about 20% from the top and ending about 80% down; the profile photo at upper right of the block.
visual.color_contrast: White text on near-black background, a blue verified badge and a gold-ringed avatar.
visual.persistent_branding: Profile photo, name 'מתן ניסטור 💎 תובנה יומית' and the handle @MatanNistor at the top of the post.
visual.visual_progression: Static for the whole 3 s; no change.
visual.cover_matches_video: yes: the cover is the same screenshot.
visual.ui_interference: The post spans about 20% to 80% of the frame, so the avatar and first lines sit near the top 14% edge and the last lines near the bottom 35% zone; the list lines 7 to 10 fall inside the bottom 35% where Instagram's overlay sits.

editing.edit_function: None: a single still frame with no edits.
editing.ending: The still ends at 3 s on the same screen; no end card or CTA in the video.
editing.loop: yes (a 3 s still that loops without a seam on replay; interpretation based on a static frame)
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: a still list that loops encourages replays and lets viewers read the ten items and pause; a looped short Reel may also inflate view counts.

sound.delivery: No speech: loudness is -90 dB for the whole Reel (silent).
sound.sync: n/a: a still with no audio.

text.colour_coding: none (white text; the pointing hand emoji is yellow).
text.placement: Centre block, about 20 to 80% height; the list is right-aligned.
text.style: Light-weight sans-serif Hebrew, small size, white on black, with numbered lines in a plain list.
text.density_and_read_time: About 50 words over 3 s: a small type size and ten list items, more than can be comfortably read in 3 s (interpretation).
text.language: A deliberately harsh tone: 'הכי מנופצים ולא רלוונטים שקיימים ואנשים אשכרה עושים אותם' with the slang 'אשכרה'; 'מדורג מהגרוע 👈 לגרוע ביותר' (a joke on ranking from bad to worst). The list: communications, economics, history, philosophy, politics and government, criminology, information systems management, industrial engineering and management, business management, political science.
text.caption_structure: One line asking viewers to write more degrees that should have made the list, with a down-pointing hand emoji; no hashtags.
text.rtl_notes: Hebrew RTL correct; the numbers sit at the right ('.1תקשורת' style, number after the Hebrew word with the dot on the wrong side), which is a left-to-right numbering artefact inside a Hebrew line.

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 43 comments, not representative. Many disagree or defend their field ('איזה שטויות, מערכות מידע סופר רלוונטי', 'הכל רלוונטי'); some comply with the prompt by naming degrees to add ('הוראה', 'משהו שקשור בחלל', 'מדעי ההתנהגות'); some say they hold one of the listed degrees ('עשיתי את מספר 7', 'עשיתי את מספר 6'); one says they read comments because he reads them.

rights_and_privacy: No third-party footage; his own post and avatar; no bystanders or minors.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a ranked list that names many popular degrees gives a large part of the audience a personal stake and a reason to argue, so the prompt in the caption collects 86 comments (0.69 per 1K views); the still requires no production and loops.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: likes per 1K views is low (5.1) among the top Reels and the video has no sound or motion; a 3 s run-time may give little time to read.

standout_moments.what: All ten degrees are visible from the first frame, so the whole content is delivered at once
The title joke 'מדורג מהגרוע 👈 לגרוע ביותר' within the list header
